name: Comet Corridor VR
summary:
Comet Corridor VR puts a whole arcade maze in front of you. The board hovers at table height, lit in neon against open space, and you steer a small fighter through it with either thumbstick. Clear every star to finish the level.

It sounds simple. Then the enemy ships arrive. Crab-clawed scouts, spinning blades, prism hunters and manta raiders patrol the lanes, and comets scream down whole corridors after their lane lights up. Your ship fires on its own while it has energy cells, so your job is the route: w
